abstract: A review of the classification, biological behavior, clinical diagnosis, and treatment of gestational trophoblastic neoplasms is presented. The events which followed the utilization of chemotherapy as a successful means of therapy are included. Especially important has been the recent recognition that high risk patients, i.e., patients with HCG titers greater than 100,000 IU/24 hr, duration of symptoms greater than four months, and metastasis to the brain and/or liver, with metastatic trophoblastic disease can be managed successfully if treated initially with combination chemotherapy and adjuvant measures including radiation and infusional therapy. Detectable levels of human chorionic gonadotropin are necessary for diagnosis and management of patients with this disease. The lack of sensitivity of commercially available pregnancy tests and the recent ability to determine HCG by means of an antigenically different beta-subunit are discussed.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性栄養膜細胞腫瘍の分類、生物学的挙動、臨床診断および治療についてレビューした。化学療法が有効な治療手段となった経緯を含めた。特に重要なのは、最近、100,000 IU/24時間を超えるhCG値、4か月以上続く症状、脳および/または肝への転移(性)病変を有する高リスク患者であっても、初期に併用化学療法と、放射線療法および持続注入療法を含む補助的措置を行えば、転移(性)栄養膜疾患を良好に管理できることが認識された点である。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の検出は、本疾患の診断と管理に必要である。市販の妊娠検査薬の感度の低さ、および最近のβサブユニットの抗原性の異なる抗体によるhCG測定の可能性について論じる。
